Container.Name: JellyfinFrontend
Container.Overview: Dense, fast web client for Jellyfin. Jellyfin stays the backend; this container only serves the UI. Set "Fixed IP address" for br0 and the Jellyfin server URL below.

Config.Name: Jellyfin server URL
Config.Description: Address of your Jellyfin server as the browser reaches it, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096. Devices connect to it without a setup screen.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: nginx inside the container. On br0 the container has its own IP, so this is not mapped; open http://[container IP]/.
